annotations.title: Query 563-Entity UMCE Rate Card Registry by Provider

description: Queries the embedded UMCE rate-card registry by vendor namespace to retrieve canonical model IDs, input/output/cache USD prices per 1M tokens, context windows, and Merkle leaf hashes. Deterministic local lookup requiring no API keys; unknown vendor slugs safely return total_matched_entities: 0 and an empty models array without error. Passing provider='all' returns the multi-vendor catalog summary, while a specific vendor slug filters strictly by namespace prefix. Use this tool when filtering the full rate-card catalog by vendor; use discover_and_probe_account_models instead at session startup to select zero-cost grant pools and flagship routing tiers.
name: list_supported_models
